article.title: Apache Patches Critical HTTP Server RCE Found by Anthropic, Google
article.summary: The mod_http2 race condition, CVE-2026-119618, could let unauthenticated attackers execute code on servers with HTTP/2 enabled. The post Apache Patches Critical HTTP Server RCE Found by Anthropic, Google appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.relevance_reason: Lỗ hổng thực thi mã từ xa (RCE) nghiêm trọng trong Apache HTTP Server được vá kịp thời, giúp ngăn chặn nguy cơ bị tấn công diện rộng trên các hệ thống máy chủ web.

article.title: New SignDrop Zero-Day Exploit Turns Windows CLFS Security Feature Into SYSTEM Access
article.summary: Public exploit code released earlier this week claims that a local Windows user can gain SYSTEM privileges through the Common Log File System driver. The proof of concept, called SignDrop, targets a log-authentication feature added to the driver last year. article.title: Critical Red Hat Quay Flaw Lets Attackers Read and Overwrite All Private Container Images in a Registry
article.summary: A critical flaw in Red Hat Quay allows an attacker who can access a Quay registry to read and overwrite private container images in every repository. Quay enables anonymous access by default, and while it is enabled, the attacker needs no account. When it is off, anyone with a valid account can still exploit the flaw, Red Hat said yesterday. article.title: PostgreSQL security update fixes 52 vulnerabilities, ends support for PostgreSQL 14
article.summary: The PostgreSQL Global Development Group released PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20 and 14.25 on November 12, fixing 52 security vulnerabilities and more than 140 other bugs. Most of those code execution bugs are memory errors or type confusion, where PostgreSQL handles a value as the wrong data type. They turn up in PL/Perl and PL/Tcl, text search functions such as ts_rank_cd(), parallel query, logical replication, dblink and statistics import. article.title: Chrome, Firefox Updates Patch Over 180 Vulnerabilities
